items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: There were big things down here... there was experiment, because you had all these hell of a trumpet players here. Manuel Perez. King Oliver. Freddie Keppard. Arnold Metoyer.

ctx.x: Yeah. Johnny Dodds. Yeah. Baby Dodds.

That’s where he had a nest, a boomerang, I’d say, to bust out. They were young then, and they were all experimenting. They had all these halls, which you don’t have in them other towns. You had 15 to 20 black halls, and that’s not counting the clubs. The Lions Club, the Bulls Club, the Saints and Sinners Club. There was another club. There was the Bears Club, or did that . . . that fizzled out. Bulls and bears, as in the stock exchange. They say if the market’s good, they call it the bulls, or the bears. It’s a…
